theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_mcr_tl_monotone_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Λ R : ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), 0 < R → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 R, m ρ ≠ ∞) → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * m ρ) (Ioo 0 R) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => m ρ / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => m ρ / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal)) ∧ ∀ σ ∈ Ioo 0 R, unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (limsup (fun ρ : ℝ => m ρ / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)).toReal * ENNReal.ofReal (σ ^ n * Real.exp (-(Λ * σ))) ≤ m σ
